description: This file defines classes and functions for parsing and handling command-line options for a style checking script related to WebKit coding style. It includes classes for default and user-specified options, argument parsing, and error handling.

classes.name: DefaultCommandOptionValues
classes.description: Stores default command-line options for check-webkit-style.

classes.name: CommandOptionValues
classes.description: Stores user-provided command-line options for check-webkit-style.

classes.name: ArgumentPrinter
classes.description: Provides methods to convert command options into command-line argument strings.

classes.name: ArgumentParser
classes.description: Handles parsing of command-line arguments for the style checking script.

methods.name: _flag_pair_to_string
methods.description: Converts a flag key-value pair into a string for command-line usage.

methods.name: to_flag_string
methods.description: Generates a command-line argument string from a CommandOptionValues instance.

methods.name: _create_option_parser
methods.description: Creates and configures an OptionParser instance for argument parsing.

methods.name: _parse_error
methods.description: Displays help and error message, then exits.

methods.name: _exit_with_categories
methods.description: Prints all style categories and default filter rules, then exits.

methods.name: _parse_filter_flag
methods.description: Parses the --filter flag into a list of filter rules.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into paths and options.
